title: Codex actually builds, tests, and verifies code .
description:
You're Only Using 10% of OpenAI Codex
Most people use OpenAI Codex like a chatbot — one prompt, one snippet. Here's the AI software team you're missing.

Codex works across three real stages: it understands your repo and turns a vague request into a plan, it builds by editing files, running commands, and operating multiple agents in parallel, and it verifies by running tests and catching failures. But the final decision never belongs to it.

Codex builds. Tests verify. Humans approve.
